Hi Lena / BrightWare ops team —

Quick heads-up: we have scheduled a precautionary live-migration maintenance window in apac-south1 tomorrow to deploy a kernel/driver fix addressing a low-frequency memory leak that surfaced under a specific tensor-concat workload. This is a safeguard update — there is no active outage, but we want to proactively apply the patch to reduce risk of degraded inference tails.

Planned window (UTC): 2026-11-25 04:00 — 08:00 UTC
Estimated per-node impact: brief live-migration (30–90s) while the node drains and warms on the target host. Your dedicated pools will be live-migrated in small cohorts; we will not evict running containers.

What to expect:
- If your requests are routed to a node in the cohort, you may see a short stall (~<90s) as the session is migrated; requests will generally retry automatically.
- We have configured intelligent fallback routing; the control plane will route traffic to healthy replicas where possible.
- Autoscaling and warm standby regions are left enabled.

Attachments: apac-south1-namespace-map.csv (cohort list), safeguard-runbook.pdf (runbook & rollback steps).

Action requested: please confirm if you have any scheduled model-rollouts or latency-sensitive campaigns that overlap this window and want us to avoid touching specific hostname prefixes. If we don’t hear from you by 2026-11-25T02:30:00Z we will proceed with the planned cohorts.

Post-maintenance: we will send a short completion summary and a link to the postmortem if any anomalies are observed.

Hannah — a couple quick technical points you can forward:
- Model pinning: pinned containers will be excluded from live-migration cohorts by default; we only migrate unpinned hosts. If BrightWare has explicit pin labels we should accept them; I verified the registry for their tenant and there are two pinned prefixes (brw-exp-*).
- SLA policy: our infra team marks transient infrastructure retries (live-migration retries) as excluded from latency SLA windows when an automatic retry is performed within the control plane. Only persistent 5xx/timeout after retry count toward SLA.
- Runbook references: see section 2.3 (pinning & cohort selection) and 4.1 (SLA handling) in safeguard-runbook.pdf.

I’ll throttle the cohort size to 8 hosts at a time and increase inter-cohort pause to 7 minutes to minimize any load risk.

—Jonas
